mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.parent_id, c.user_id, c.content, COALESCE(u.nickname, c.nickname) AS nickname, c.email, c.website, COALESCE(u.avatar, c.avatar) AS avatar, c.status, c.create_time FROM comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = #{status} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.parent_id, c.user_id, c.content, COALESCE(u.nickname, c.nickname) AS nickname, c.email, c.website, COALESCE(u.avatar, c.avatar) AS avatar, c.status, c.create_time FROM comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_id = 0 AND c.status = #{status} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, parent_id, user_id, content, nickname, email, website, avatar, status) VALUES (#{postId}, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{website}, #{avatar}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.content, c.user_id, COALESCE(u.nickname, c.nickname) AS nickname, COALESCE(u.avatar, c.avatar) AS avatar, c.create_time, p.title AS post_title FROM comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id JOIN post p ON p.id = c.post_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 WHERE c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
